from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """A financial metric extracted from a single company's report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the report belongs to")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the financial metric as written in the document")
    metric_value: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the metric; negative values indicate outflows or losses")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by this metric (e.g., '2024 Q1')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_records: list[FinancialRecord]
